name: NetDeck
releaseNotes: First release: network diagnostics decks for connectivity, DNS, domain/RDAP intelligence, HTTP/TLS, path and speed probes, with evidence-labelled results and exportable captures.
description: NetDeck is an Android network toolkit that answers whether a network, domain, or server is healthy and why. It bundles connectivity, DNS, domain registration, HTTP/TLS, path, and speed probes with evidence-first results that label source, timestamp, method, and confidence, plus exportable captures you can re-run later to compare measurements.
